slices.title: Org agent policy registry in capability-core
slices.summary: Adds the org agent policy registry in capability-core as system of record (DEC-14): a versioned document per org with typed keys (mode_cap, rung_cap, lockdown, extension allow-lists, approval floors and reserved keys), an admin-only PUT with If-Match revision checks, member reads, an effective-policy read and an append-only history with content-free audit rows; writes are refused for ZDR principals. Enforcement comes in S9. Behind ORG_AGENT_POLICY_API (off returns 404).

cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p mp-contracts org_agent_policy

slices.title: Consent contract: schema, Control binding, create verification, card
slices.summary: Adds a stored-consent contract to schedule create: a read-only class ceiling and a mandatory expiry (30 d default, 90 d max), signed by Control in its create decision with a digest that capability-core and the gateway recompute and verify against the tool registry, plus a consent card in the dialog. Off unless SCHEDULE_CONTRACT_ENABLED is set; a schedule without a contract stays draft-only.

slices.title: Org-core browser site policy store and API
slices.summary: Adds the org-core browser-site policy of record: org_browser_site_policy (open or allowlist mode, revision), org_browser_site_rules (block, read or act per host), user_browser_site_prefs (200 per user, expires_at defaulting to 90 days), and an append-only org_browser_site_history, with RLS by org. Adds an internal resolve endpoint returning deny, ask, read or act with source and revision, plus admin and user APIs with expected_revision checks (409 on conflict); no caller until S4.
